results_audit_status: Independent C scientific/artifact audit was pending at figure generation; this pass covers recorded numbers and visual layout.

interpretation.defensible: Procedural waveform training covering independent camera and microphone orientations supports audio-plus-known-pose viewport prediction in held-out real rooms. The matched-orientation head fails when camera-only pose variation introduces a shift beyond its training support; pose-aware training largely avoids that failure.
interpretation.necessary_counter_result: Canonical matched-orientation training is descriptively higher in the co-rig regime with relative pose zero:0.8409 versus 0.8319. The pose-aware curriculum is therefore not universally better. The co-rig regime matches the canonical training support.
interpretation.analytic_reference: Analytic intensity plus known pose already achieves 0.7817 balanced accuracy without head training. The pose-aware camera-only gain is 0.04762; the paired seven-room percentile interval is 0.00675–0.10377, conditional on these prespecified rooms. Seven clusters and one benchmark support a bounded preliminary claim, without universal superiority or population guarantees.
interpretation.localization_separation: The median angular error of 23.48 degrees versus 50.14 for constant front measures analytic FOA localization. The MLP predicts only binary viewport availability; its curriculum cannot be credited with improving continuous DOA estimation.
interpretation.pose_support: Pose-aware training and test both use the four headings 0/90/180/270. This is transfer to real acoustics and rooms, not generalization to unseen continuous yaw or unknown extrinsics. The canonical baseline sees relative pose zero only, so its inability to learn a pose interaction is expected.
interpretation.negative_control: The cyclic wrong-pose labels intentionally make training data invalid. Their failure is a specificity/sanity check, not evidence of superiority over a competitive augmentation method.
interpretation.task_and_class_balance: The target is geometric viewport availability from external source-position labels and known pose. It does not establish unoccluded visibility, audibility, object identity, distance estimation, unknown-pose calibration, or learned audiovisual fusion. View positivity is 25%; raw accuracy alone would be misleading, while balanced accuracy has a 0.5 constant-class reference.
interpretation.dependence: Both regimes reuse the original sound field and windows. Equal analytic scores across regimes reflect equivariance, not independent replication. The five learned seeds are not five independent real datasets.
interpretation.year1_bridge: Future work should test actual visual features/source binding, unseen angles and extrinsics, and matched synthetic-generator alternatives. The present results justify feasibility and a precise curriculum question; they do not establish a new photorealistic audiovisual synthesis capability.

recommended_proposal_paragraph: On 168 prespecified half-second windows from 14 real recordings in 7 held-out rooms, a head trained with procedural audio and independent camera poses achieved 0.829 balanced accuracy for geometric viewport availability under camera-only reframing, versus 0.480 for matched-orientation training and 0.782 for an analytic intensity baseline. Under co-rig rotation, which matches the canonical training pose support, canonical training reached 0.841 versus 0.832 for pose-aware training. These results support the feasibility of explicit camera–microphone pose control and real-room measurement. They do not establish universal curriculum superiority or learned audiovisual fusion.
recommendation: Include both regimes in the proposal text or table; do not present the camera-only plot without its co-rig counter-result.
